newsitem.title: BELGIUM: OLOs seen lower if French, German GDP data diverge.
newsitem.headline: OLOs seen lower if French, German GDP data diverge.

text.p: Belgian linear bonds (OLOs) recouped early losses on Tuesday but some dealers said the move could be reversed if data later this week shows the French and German economies are growing apart.
However they said volumes would likely remain subdued until the key U.S. August jobs report is out of the way on Friday.

Data to be released at 0645 GMT on Wednesday is expected to show the French economy contracted by 0.2 percent in the second quarter compared with the first, raising new doubts about the country's ability to meet the Maastricht single currency criteria.
